q: Which landfill gas projects qualify under CCTS methodology BM WA03.002?
title: Landfill gas under BM WA03.002
short: BM WA03.002 covers a new landfill gas capture system, or investment that raises recovery at an existing one where the gas was only vented or flared. The gas can be flared, burnt for power or heat, or supplied through a gas network, by truck or by dedicated pipeline.
audience: Landfill operators, city bodies and gas buyers

sections.h: Allowed uses of the captured gas
ul: Heat in a boiler, air heater, brick kiln or glass melting furnace.
Supply to consumers through a natural gas distribution network or a dedicated pipeline.
Compressed or liquefied gas delivered by truck.
Either a new capture system where none would have been installed, or an investment in an existing system whose gas was vented or flared and not used.
For an existing system whose gas cannot be measured separately, historical data on gas captured and flared is needed.
The project must not reduce organic waste that would have been recycled.
Adapted from UNFCCC CDM methodology ACM0001 (version valid from 14 June 2019).
